summary: Frontend-only end-to-end verification of the MIPS-inspired TRUSTED-V redesign. Logged in as admin@trusted-v.com and verified Landing, About, ProductSuite, Contact (incl. form submission to /api/applications/sales-inquiry), Marketplace, DeveloperPortal, IDEDownloads, WebIDE, Partners, and all 3 sub-product pages (secure-boot, crypto-stack, rtos-benchmark). Navigation, fonts, theme, and CTAs verified. All 21 review items PASS with only two minor cosmetic observations.

Right form has all fields with data-testids: input-first-name, input-last-name, input-email, input-company, input-country, input-interest (select), input-message, contact-submit

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: nav 'Request a demo' button does not have an explicit data-testid attribute (e.g. nav-request-demo). Text is present and clickable but consider adding data-testid for testability.
Minor: on /product-suite the word 'Enterprise' pricing tier was not matched by a coarse text search; visually verified but consider ensuring 'Enterprise' text is not clipped/overridden. Non-blocking.
seed_data_creation: None. One sales-inquiry submission with 'TEST_John Doe' was created via contact form to verify the /api/applications/sales-inquiry integration (backend returned success, toast rendered).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full MIPS-inspired redesign is verified working end-to-end for admin flow. All key data-testids exist on interactive elements. Contact form → /api/applications/sales-inquiry integration confirmed working. Only two minor cosmetic observations (missing data-testid on nav demo button, Enterprise word visual check).
